s: The book of the generation of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of «Abraham».
Abraham begat Isaac; and Isaac begat Jacob; and Jacob begat Judas and his «brethren»;
For John had said unto Herod, It is not lawful for thee to have thy «brother»’s wife.
And Zorobabel begat «Abiud»; and Abiud begat Eliakim; and Eliakim begat Azor;

G40.d: religious awe; to venerate; dedicated to the gods, sacred; holy; Its highest application is to God himself, in his purity, majesty, and glory; of persons employed by him, as angels; Applied to persons as separated to God's service; In the moral sense of sharing God's purity; Of pure, clean sacrifices and offerings …
s: I indeed have baptized you with water: but he shall baptize you with the «Holy» Ghost.
And the graves were opened; and many bodies of the «saints» which slept arose,

G32.d: a messenger; one sent; angel; a messenger or delegate; a bishop or ruler; a guardian angel
s: Then the devil leaveth him, and, behold, «angels» came and ministered unto him.
As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my «messenger» before thy face, which shall prepare thy way before thee.

G66.d: living in fields, wild; savage, fierce
s: And John was clothed with camel’s hair, and with a girdle of a skin about his loins; and he did eat locusts and «wild» honey;

G27.d: beloved; by God; by Christians, of one another
s: And lo a voice from heaven, saying, This is my «beloved» Son, in whom I am well pleased.
The elder unto the «wellbeloved» Gaius, whom I love in the truth.

G21.d: to glorify; to exult in; to exult, rejoice greatly
s: And my spirit hath «rejoiced» in God my Saviour.
And whosoever shall «compel» thee to go a mile, go with him twain.

G25.d: to love; Of human affection, to men; Of divine love; God's love; Christ's love
s: Honour thy father and thy mother: and, Thou shalt «love» thy neighbour as thyself.
To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the «beloved».
For Demas hath forsaken me, «having» «loved» this present world, and is departed unto Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, Titus unto Dalmatia.
And Jesus said unto him, Why callest thou me «good»? none is good, save one, that is, God.
Dare any of you, having a matter against another, go to law before the «unjust», and not before the saints?
If therefore ye have not been faithful in the «unrighteous» mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

G37.d: to make holy, consecrate, sanctify; to dedicate, separate,  set apart for God; to purify; make conformable in character to such dedication; In the intermediate sense of ceremonial or levitical purification; to treat as holy
s: For it is «sanctified» by the word of God and prayer.
After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, «Hallowed» be thy name.

G68.d: a field; the country; country places, farms; a piece of ground
s: Neither let him which is in the «field» return back to take his clothes.
And they took counsel, and bought with them the potter’s «field», to bury strangers in.
And there was a good way off from them an «herd» of many swine feeding.
No man putteth a piece of «new» cloth unto an old garment, for that which is put in to fill it up taketh from the garment, and the rent is made worse.

G71.d: to lead, bring, carry; to lead, guide, impel; to spend; keep
s: They «brought» to the Pharisees him that aforetime was blind.
Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and «bring» him with thee: for he is profitable to me for the ministry.
And the whole multitude of them arose, and «led» him unto Pilate.

G58.d: to bring together; an assembly; a place of assembly; a public place; forum; a market-place
s: And greetings in the «markets», and to be called of men, Rabbi, Rabbi.

G86.d: Hades; the abode of Hades, the underivorld
s: And thou, Capernaum, which art exalted to heaven, shalt be thrust down to «hell».
And she had a «sister» called Mary, which also sat at Jesus’ feet, and heard his word.

G59.d: to buy in the market; purchase
s: And they took counsel, and «bought» with them the potter’s field, to bury strangers in.
(For his disciples were gone away unto the city to «buy» meat.)

And they sung as it were a new song before the throne, and before the four beasts, and the elders: and no man could learn that song but the hundred and forty and four thousand, which were «redeemed» from the earth.

Notwithstanding, lest we should offend them, go thou to the sea, and cast an «hook», and take up the fish that first cometh up; and when thou hast opened his mouth, thou shalt find a piece of money: that take, and give unto them for me and thee.

G91.d: do wrong, act wickedly; criminally; to do hurt; wrong; to wrong; suffer . . . to be wronged; to injure, hurt
s: And they had tails like unto scorpions, and there were stings in their tails: and their power was to «hurt» men five months.
Nay, ye do «wrong», and defraud, and that your brethren.

G23.d: much; to grieve; to be indignant
s: And when the ten heard it, they were moved with «indignation» against the two brethren.
And to Jesus the mediator of the new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling, that speaketh better things than that of «Abel».

G26.d: love, goodwill, esteem; Of men's love; Of divine love; God's love; Christ's love to men; love feasts; friendship; natural affection; sexual love
s: And because iniquity shall abound, the «love» of many shall wax cold.
And now abideth faith, hope, «charity», these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
But the wise took oil in their «vessels» with their lamps.
And he taketh with him Peter and James and John, and began to be sore amazed, and to be very «heavy»;
How he went into the house of God in the days of «Abiathar» the high priest, and did eat the shewbread, which is not lawful to eat but for the priests, and gave also to them which were with him?

G50.d: to be ignorant; not to know; a Pauline phrase; not to understand
s: Now concerning spiritual gifts, brethren, I would not have you «ignorant».
But they «understood» not that saying, and were afraid to ask him.
And was «unknown» by face unto the churches of Judaea which were in Christ:
And they send unto him certain of the Pharisees and of the Herodians, to «catch» him in his words.

G69.d: seeking sleep; to be sleepless, wakeful; to be watchful, vigilant
s: Take ye heed, «watch» and pray: for ye know not when the time is.
And because ye are sons, God hath sent forth the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, «Abba», Father.
And no man taketh this honour unto himself, but he that is called of God, as was «Aaron».
And thou shalt have joy and «gladness»; and many shall rejoice at his birth.
And there were in the same country shepherds abiding in the «field», keeping watch over their flock by night.
Then took he him up in his «arms», and blessed God, and said,

G9.d: Abilene; a district in the Anti-Lebanon
s: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Cæsar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judæa, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of Ituraea and of the region of Trachonitis, and Lysanias the tetrarch of «Abilene»,
Which was the son of Melchi, which was the son of «Addi», which was the son of Cosam, which was the son of Elmodam, which was the son of Er,
For as in «Adam» all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.

G61.d: the chase, a hunting; catching; that which is taken, a catch
s: For he was astonished, and all that were with him, at the «draught» of the fishes which they had taken:

G15.d: to do good; for another's benefit
s: And if ye do «good» to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.
Even as Sara obeyed Abraham, calling him lord: whose daughters ye are, as long as ye do «well», and are not afraid with any amazement.

G12.d: boundless, bottomless; the abyss; of the underworld, as the abode of the dead
s: And they besought him that he would not command them to go «out» into the deep.

G82.d: unseen, unobserved, not manifest; uncertain, indistinct
s: Woe unto you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! for ye are as graves which «appear» not, and the men that walk over them are not aware of them.

G75.d: to contend for a prize; to fight, struggle, strive
s: «Fight» the good fight of faith, lay hold on eternal life, whereunto thou art also called, and hast professed a good profession before many witnesses.

G93.d: injustice; unrighteousness, iniquity; an unrighteous act
s: What shall we say then? Is there «unrighteousness» with God? God forbid.
For I perceive that thou art in the gall of bitterness, and in the bond of «iniquity».

G74.d: a contest, wrestling; great fear, agony, anguish
s: And being in an «agony» he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.

G48.d: to purify; cleanse from defilement; ceremonially; morally
s: Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you. Cleanse your hands, ye sinners; and «purify» your hearts, ye double minded.
And now, brethren, I wot that through «ignorance» ye did it, as did also your rulers.

G62.d: dwelling in the field; to live in the fields
s: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and perceived that they were unlearned and «ignorant» men, they marvelled; and they took knowledge of them, that they had been with Jesus.
And as we tarried there many days, there came down from Judæa a certain prophet, named «Agabus».

G14.d: to do good, show kindness; to do good
s: That they do «good», that they be rich in good works, ready to distribute, willing to communicate;
For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE «UNKNOWN» GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.
For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her «iniquities».

Then Paul took the men, and the next day purifying himself with them entered into the temple, to signify the accomplishment of the days of «purification», until that an offering should be offered for every one of them.
And after certain days king «Agrippa» and Bernice came unto Cæsarea to salute Festus.
And entering into a ship of «Adramyttium», we launched, meaning to sail by the coasts of Asia; one Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica, being with us.

G99.d: the Adriatic; in later Greek usage extended to take in all the waters between Greece and Italy
s: But when the fourteenth night was come, as we were driven up and down in «Adria», about midnight the shipmen deemed that they drew near to some country;
Then fearing lest we should have fallen upon rocks, they cast four «anchors» out of the stern, and wished for the day.
And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of «holiness», by the resurrection from the dead:

G96.d: not standing the test, rejected; rejected after testing, reprobate
s: Now as Jannes and Jambres withstood Moses, so do these also resist the truth: men of corrupt minds, «reprobate» concerning the faith.
For God hath not called us unto uncleanness, but unto «holiness».
That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in «sanctification» and honour;
That I have great «heaviness» and continual sorrow in my heart.

G65.d: of the wild olive; the wild olive
s: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a «wild» «olive» «tree», wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
(For the fruit of the Spirit is in all «goodness» and righteousness and truth;)

G36.d: unborn; of no family, ignoble, base
s: And «base» things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, yea, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are:
I say therefore to the «unmarried» and widows, It is good for them if they abide even as I.
What is my reward then? Verily that, when I preach the gospel, I may make the gospel of Christ without «charge», that I abuse not my power in the gospel.
I therefore so run, not as «uncertainly»; so fight I, not as one that beateth the air:
For so is the will of God, that with well doing ye may put to silence the «ignorance» of foolish men:
In stripes, in imprisonments, in tumults, in labours, in «watchings», in fastings;
By «pureness», by knowledge, by longsuffering, by kindness, by the Holy Ghost, by love unfeigned,

For behold this selfsame thing, that ye sorrowed after a godly sort, what carefulness it wrought in you, yea, what clearing of yourselves, yea, what «indignation», yea, what fear, yea, what vehement desire, yea, what zeal, yea, what revenge! In all things ye have approved yourselves to be clear in this matter.

G53.d: free from ceremonial defilement; holy; sacred; venerable; pure; chaste; undefiled; guiltless; of persons; of things; sincere
s: Lay hands suddenly on no man, neither be partaker of other men’s sins: keep thyself «pure».
Which things are an allegory: for these are the two covenants; the one from the mount Sinai, which gendereth to bondage, which is «Agar».

G73.d: a gathering; a place of assembly; a contest, struggle, trial; of the Christian life as a contest and struggle; solicitude, anxiety
s: Having the same «conflict» which ye saw in me, and now hear to be in me.
The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all «purity».
Charge them that are rich in this world, that they be not highminded, nor trust in «uncertain» riches, but in the living God, who giveth us richly all things to enjoy;

G72.d: a carrying away; a leading, guiding; training; conduct, way of life

s: Without father, «without» mother, «without» descent, having neither beginning of days, nor end of life; but made like unto the Son of God; abideth a priest continually.

G39.d: religious awe; to venerate; dedicated to the gods, sacred; holy; Its highest application is to God himself, in his purity, majesty, and glory; of persons employed by him, as angels; Applied to persons as separated to God's service; In the moral sense of sharing God's purity; Of pure, clean sacrifices and offerings …
s: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the «holiest» by the blood of Jesus,
And after the second veil, the tabernacle which is called the «Holiest» of all;

G41.d: sanctity; holiness; regarded, properly, as an abstract quality
s: For they verily for a few days chastened us after their own pleasure; but he for our profit, that we might be partakers of his «holiness».

G87.d: not to be parted, mixed, undistinguishable; without uncertainty

s: Or unto governors, as unto them that are sent by him for the punishment of evildoers, and for the praise of them that do «well».

G81.d: brotherhood, brotherly affection; the brotherhood; the Christian community
s: Honour all men. Love the «brotherhood». Fear God. Honour the king.
For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering «wrongfully».
Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in «well» «doing», as unto a faithful Creator.
For this is the «message» that ye heard from the beginning, that we should love one another.
I am «Alpha» and Omega, the beginning and the end, the first and the last.
And they had a king over them, which is the angel of the bottomless pit, whose name in the Hebrew tongue is «Abaddon», but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon.
